error.description: Why the item has no job: the CA is invalid, or status 'failed' with 'quota_exceeded' / 'overloaded' when that item was rejected (others still queue)
error.title: Error

retry_after_s.description: For a rejected item: seconds to wait before retrying it
retry_after_s.title: Retry After S

callback_url.description: Optional https URL that receives a signed JobResponse per finished job
callback_url.title: Callback Url

cas.description: CAs to prefetch. Use `items` instead to pass hints; both may be combined (at most 50 in total, at least one)
cas.title: Cas

where.description: Which input it came from: name, symbol, description, image, x, trend, chain, db
where.title: Where

pair.description: The token the coin trades against (from quote_mint)

Pair.description:
The token the coin trades against on its bonding curve. SOL and stablecoins carry no
meaning; any other token feeds the analysis (category crypto_native/paired_ecosystem,
derivative/pair_family when the name builds on it, flag non_sol_pair).

builds_on.description: The coin's name or ticker builds on the pair token's
builds_on.title: Builds On

referent.description: What the pair token itself refers to, when known

source.description: Where the pair token was identified: neutral (SOL/stablecoin), known_coin, analysis (a stored TokenSage analysis), db, onchain, none
source.title: Source

Pair.title: Pair

TokenHints.description:
Metadata the caller already holds (e.g. from pump.fun). Untrusted: cleaned and
URL-checked exactly like fetched metadata. When present, the IPFS metadata fetch is
skipped, and a mint not yet visible on-chain is analysed instead of returning 404.

created_at.description: Token creation time; skips the on-chain history lookup
created_at.title: Created At

TokenHints.title: TokenHints

TokenRequest.description: Optional body of POST /v1/tokens/{ca} (the query parameters are those of GET).
TokenRequest.title: TokenRequest

XAccount.description:
An account involved in the linked post. Its display name and handle are read like
the post text (a reply to @elonmusk points at Elon Musk).
XAccount.title: XAccount

accounts.description: Accounts involved: author (or linked profile), quoted and replied-to authors, @mentions (full depth)
accounts.title: Accounts

match.description: Post/profile vs token comparison (full depth, tweet or profile links)

quoted.description: Present when the linked tweet is a quote tweet (full depth)

replied_to.description: Present when the linked tweet is a reply (full depth)

XMatch.description: How well the linked X post (or profile) matches the token (depth=full).

x_categories.description: Categories of the post text read on its own
x_categories.title: X Categories

XMatch.title: XMatch

best_distance.description: Smallest perceptual-hash Hamming distance to the logo
best_distance.title: Best Distance

agrees.description: Whether it is the referent the name, ticker and image point to on their own; null when either side has no confident referent
agrees.title: Agrees

x_label.description: What the post alone is about
x_label.title: X Label

XQuoted.description:
A tweet the linked tweet points at (full depth): the one it quotes (x.quoted) or the
one it replies to (x.replied_to). Often the real narrative: a launch post that quotes
or answers someone else's earlier post.

predates_token_by_s.description: Seconds the post predates the token; negative if after
predates_token_by_s.title: Predates Token By S

XQuoted.title: XQuoted

info.description: Explains what a pump.fun token means, given its contract address. Deterministic analysis of name, ticker, image and linked X/Twitter content.
info.title: TokenSage
